description: SERP competitors: the domains that rank in Google for a set of up to 100 keywords, each with average and median position, visibility, estimated traffic and how many of the keywords it ranks for; up to 100 domains in one $0.048 call. Use when you need who owns the search results of a topic. No data returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

keywords.description: Keywords whose Google results to analyse (1-100; each at most 80 characters, normalised to lower case; one that is then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is listed in missing).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum domains to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

name: serp_competitors
title: Domains ranking for a keyword set (up to 100)
